title: Explore Engineering Program
gradYearEvidence: Open to first- and second-year students graduating between December 2028 and June 2030.
description: A 12-week summer rotation program for underclassmen covering software engineering and product management. No prior internship required.

title: STEP Software Intern
gradYearEvidence: Candidates must be in their first or second year with an expected graduation of 2029 or 2030.
description: Paired-programming internship for first- and second-year CS students. Interns ship a real feature with a mentor.

title: Tech Insight Week
gradYearEvidence: This program is designed exclusively for college freshmen.
description: A one-week paid program introducing freshmen to engineering at a trading firm. Includes workshops, a mini hackathon and mentorship.

title: Open Source Fellowship
gradYearEvidence: All class years welcome; first- and second-year students are strongly encouraged.
description: A 12-week remote fellowship contributing to open-source projects with maintainers as mentors. Stipend provided.

title: HackFall 2026
gradYearEvidence: Open to all current university students, beginners encouraged.
description: A 36-hour beginner-friendly hackathon with workshops, mentors and a first-timer prize track.

title: Summer Research Experience in ML
gradYearEvidence: Applicants should be rising juniors (expected graduation 2029).
description: 10-week funded undergraduate research in machine learning with housing and a stipend.

title: Frontend Engineering Extern
gradYearEvidence: Must be a sophomore graduating in 2029.
description: Part-time spring externship building UI components alongside the design systems team.

title: Bridge Tech Scholars
gradYearEvidence: For first-year students pursuing computing degrees.
description: Scholarship plus a year of mentorship and interview prep for first-year students from underrepresented backgrounds.

title: Underclassmen Datathon
description: A one-day data science competition with cash prizes and fast-track interviews for top teams.

title: Software Engineering Discovery Internship
gradYearEvidence: Open to students with a graduation date between 2029 and 2030.
description: Summer internship for early-career students, with a team project, weekly tech talks and a final demo day.

title: Civic Code Summer Fellow
description: Build software for local governments and nonprofits in a cohort of 20 fellows.

title: First-Year Robotics Lab Assistant
gradYearEvidence: Open to members of the Class of 2030.
